events.title: The last level has been developed
events.summary: Congratulations! If you've been following the game's development, I have some good news. As of today, Missy has received an alpha version. The development of all seven levels has already been completed, and the final tests and preparations for Stem Next Fest are ahead. There's very little left until the release of this cozy game, and I'll be happy to show you Missy's watercolor world.

events.title: A little about the current development
events.summary: I recently finished working on another level (the one with the big fish). My immediate plans include releasing a new video for the Ukrainian Game Festival. I'll also continue working toward the 2026 release date. Missi is now a one-man project, and its success depends entirely on my persistence. Thank you to everyone who supports the project. I saw people playing the demo on YouTube, and it was incredibly moving for me.

events.title: Missy has a demo!
events.summary: Congratulations, today is an incredibly exciting event related to the release of the demo game. It has been a truly challenging and interesting journey.The demo will show the first two levels of the adventure, which will take you to the mouse hole and the forest. I hope you enjoy the puzzles and the drawn graphics that we have created for you.

events.title: Missi has received her first gameplay trailer! Gramophone and Wasp Queen include
events.summary: We’re so thrilled – seriously! We’re happy to present our very first game trailer featuring new puzzles, animations, and charming characters. The trailer’s release coincides with the Steam Animal Fest 2025, where Missi will take part. Thank you to everyone who’s been waiting for the game and supporting our work.

events.title: Participation in the Ukrainian Games Festival 2025
events.summary: Greetings, friends!Today, the team is actively working on the release of the demo, which is scheduled for September-October and will show the first two locations out of seven.In the meantime, our mouse is participating in the Ukrainian Games Festival 2025 thanks to Indie Cup and Palaye. Thank you all for your support and we will be grateful for adding the game to the wishlist!

events.title: Indie Cup 2024 and plans for 2025
events.summary: The Indie Cup 2024 has just ended, where the game made it to the finals and was nominated in two categories. This is an inspiring result, considering that development started not so long ago. The jury praised us for the graphics, logical puzzles and convenient controls. In December, an experienced developer joined the team and we hope that the work will go according to plan. events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175806/6a115c741c2b740a9add00da3c96d6999ec672f0.jpg Hi everyone! We continue to work on the game and are happy to see every new subscriber to our community. Today, achievements that many Steam users love so much were added to the game. In parallel, we are creating new puzzles and art for swamp levels.
